limitations: Only ternary length three and coalition bound two. Bibliographic originality remains subject to unindexed earlier enumerations; some relevant older papers were not accessible in full text. No independent external audit.
scientific_integrity: An exhaustive finite classification, with two independent algorithms and complete labeled catalogue. Historical maximum-cardinality results are treated as background; originality pertains to saturated nonmaximum codes and their orbit/extension structure.
title: The complete saturation spectrum of ternary length-three two-frameproof codes
